question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Prey
solution:
The correct answer is '​**Predator**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Prey**' is '**Predator**'.
 
• **Prey**: an animal or bird that is killed and eaten by another animal or bird. (एक पशु या पक्षी द्वारा मार कर खाया गया अन्‍य पशु या पक्षी; शिकार)
